t: Депутаты обсудят отчет об исполнении федерального бюджета за 2025 год

de: During the plenary session on October 13, State Duma deputies will discuss the report on the implementation of the federal budget for 2025, as well as the budgets of the Social Fund and the Compulsory Medical Insurance Fund.

te: Trump said that Putin is more interested in resolving the conflict
de: U.S. President Donald Trump said that Russian leader Vladimir Putin to a greater extent than Volodymyr Zelensky, is set to conclude a deal to resolve the Ukrainian conflict.
